_comment: Spec 004 / T035 + spec 005 FR-017 — single source of truth for the six ZoneIdentity rows. The Rust side (src-tauri/src/zones/zone_id.rs) and the TS side (src/components/DropZone.identity.ts) both assert against this fixture in their drift-detection tests. Update all three together when changing any per-zone string. Spec 005 extended hint_copy for all six zones to list all four supported input formats (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .md).
